schema: k2b_cells/v2: resolve by COMPUTE CAPABILITY first (by_cc), device-name substring only as secondary (by_name); unknown cc -> K2B package default. Needs the cc-aware loader (k2b_loader_cc.patch applied to fpf_triatt_k2b/triatt_k2b.py, or cells/k2b_cells.py::resolve); an UNPATCHED K2B v1.1 loader still works through the v1-compat top-level name keys below (name match only). Enable: export PF_TRIATTN_TABLE=<this file>.

sm100.status: checked: NVIDIA B200 (cc 10.0), triton 3.6.0 and 3.7.1; 80/80 torch.equal vs default

sm103.status: checked: NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC (cc 10.3), torch 2.10.0+cu128 / triton 3.6.0 (its bundled ptxas-blackwell assembles sm_103): 64/64 torch.equal vs the package default (D=32 bf16, H 4/8, N 256/356/546/705/813/1493/1775/2560, block-0-like and late-block-like synthetic pair inputs, unmasked and 10 %-masked with one fully-masked row) and run-to-run 5/5; interleaved 5-round timing vs the package default (MAXNREG 144 on this triton) x1.021-1.063 at every N x H measured (256..2560), never slower; the sm100 cell (3 stages, MAXNREG 128) is also torch.equal here but x0.966-0.988 at ragged N (356/546/813/1493/1775) and x1.088-1.093 at N 1024/2048/2560, so B300 takes 2 stages; 192-cell grid: 0 build failures, 24 cells bitwise == default (the 64|128 x 32 x 2-row tile family), none faster than this one at every size; measured 2026-09-07

sm120.status: checked: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (cc 12.0), triton 3.6.0; 16/16 torch.equal vs default

sm90.status: checked: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (cc 9.0), torch 2.7.1 / triton 3.3.1: torch.equal vs the served default (MAXNREG 144 on triton 3.3.1) AND r2r at 12/12 points (start b0c1 + end b47c10; 356/546/705/813/1493/1775; real dumps H=8 D=32), x1.114-1.153 per call, ratio_rms vs fp64 unchanged, 380-config sweep found nothing better; on the pinned v0.5.1rc2 bytes: CLI DET T*(MAXNREG 128) == T*(144) 12/12 @356/705 + r2r 12/12, same-box bracket @705 x5 trunk x1.038 / per prediction x1.026; in-model @1493 x1.038 per prediction. sm80.status: verified: NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe (cc 8.0), torch 2.13.0+cu130 / triton 3.7.1; no bitwise-equal candidate >= 3 % faster than the package default (best x0.985); entry pins the default's own values; torch.equal vs the package default at 7/7 confirm points x top candidates + 6/6 battery points (masked+unmasked, H=4/12, N 256..2560), r2r 5/5; err vs fp64 ratio to torch-bf16 math worst rms 0.999; A100 sweep 2026-09-06 (synthetic inputs, D=32 bf16)

__doc__.what: Per-arch launch cells for the FlashPairformer K2B v1.1 flash triangle-attention kernel (third_party/fpf_triatt_k2b/triatt_k2b.py), in K2B's own PF_TRIATTN_TABLE format: top-level key = substring of torch.cuda.get_device_name(0); value = {dtype: {head_dim: [[max_seq, cfg], ...]}}. Enable with: export PF_TRIATTN_TABLE=<path to this file> (no code change; K2B prints nothing extra; check fpf_triatt_k2b.K2B._PF_TABLE_KEY / pick_config()). Devices without an entry (H100 sm_90, A100, L40S ...) keep the package default (64x32, ROWS 2, 4 warps, 3 stages, MAXNREG 128 on triton>=3.7 else 144). Every entry below is OUTPUT-BITWISE-IDENTICAL to the package default on that device, so K2B v1.1's Tier-2 label and certificates apply unchanged.

sm_100 (NVIDIA B200).rule: default tile, MAXNREG=128 on EVERY triton version (K2B's built-in rule resolves 144 on triton<3.7, which costs x1.13-1.14 on sm_100 at every size)
sm_100 (NVIDIA B200).evidence: B200 180GB, synthetic model-like inputs (bf16 q/k/v, bf16-exact permuted fp32 bias), CUDA-event median of 20, in-run cuEq 0.11.1 (cudnn sm80 FMHA path). 40 rows per stack = N {356,546,705,813} x H {8,4} x MAXNREG {uncapped,96,112,128,144}: ALL rows torch.equal vs MAXNREG=144 AND vs uncapped, r2r bitwise; 128 is the fastest cap in 15/16 (N,H) cells per image (356 H=8 on t3.6.0: 112 by 0.4 us); x(128 over 144) = 1.121-1.143, x(128 over uncapped) = 1.126-1.144, x(128 over cuEq) = 2.17-2.46. Mechanism check through PF_TRIATTN_TABLE on triton 3.6.0: pick_config -> MAXNREG 128, table output bitwise == explicit-128 == explicit-144, 2.154 vs 2.453 ms @705 H=8.

__doc__.sm_103 (NVIDIA B300): checked on NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC (cc 10.3, torch 2.10 / triton 3.6.0): entry sm103 = the 64x32, 2-row, 4-warp tile at 2 stages with MAXNREG 128 — torch.equal to the package default at 64/64 battery points, x1.02-1.06 over it at N 256..2560 (the 3-stage sm100 cell is slower than the default at ragged N on this card).

sm_120 (NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Se.why: same tile as the package default with the register cap REMOVED (MAXNREG=0/None): bitwise-identical output to the default (torch.equal) on 16/16 module cells (356/546/705/813 x b0/b47 x start/end), r2r 16/16, same-class vs fp64 (ratio_max 0.988-1.000); faster than the default at EVERY size: x1.06 @356, x1.07-1.13 @546, x1.03-1.05 @705, x1.10 @813 (kernel); vs cuEq cudnn_sm80 x1.53/1.73-1.81/1.60-1.64/1.91-1.93

rejected_alternatives.why_rejected: fastest in the 705-only sweep (2.074 vs 2.240 ms, bitwise vs default) but SLOWER than the default at 546 (x0.68-0.71) and 813 (x0.97); size-dependent -> not a table entry unless the table is keyed by N
sweep @705: 2.264 ms vs 2.169 uncapped vs 2.240 at 144 -> the cap that helps sm_100 (x1.14, SM100 track) does NOT help sm_120

__doc__.not adopted on sm_100: 128x32 ROWS1 4 warps 3 stages MAXNREG 128: x1.03-1.05 over the B200 entry @705 with the same error class but NOT bitwise to default -> would need its own Tier-2 sign-off; gain too small. fpf_triatt_sm100 (tcgen05/TMA Triton port): 2.03-2.06 ms @705 H=8 = parity with the B200 entry; engineering artifact only (notes not included in this package).
__doc__.loader: patched loader prints once per process: '[triatt_k2b] K2B cells: cc=(x, y) name=... -> entry <key> via cc|name(secondary) (MAXNREG=...)' or '-> no entry (...); package default (MAXNREG=...)'. Unit test: python cells/k2b_cells.py cells/K2B_CELLS.json (8 fake cc/name pairs incl. H200 -> default, unknown-name cc 10.0 -> sm100).
__doc__.context (NOT an entry; different provide: Landscape @705 tok H=8 on B200, kernel-only per call: cuEq 0.11.1 sm80-cuDNN path 5.14 ms | K2B v1.1 @MAXNREG128 (this file's sm100 entry) 2.12 ms | cuEquivariance cu13 build's sm100-native cuDNN tri-attention ('sm100f', needs S_kv % 8 == 0 -> pad-8 shim) 1.38 ms (probe track, 2026-08-23).
